name: Nikola Bartůňková
intro: Nikola Bartůňková is a 20-year-old from Prague, Czechia. She is one of the newest stars in tennis. She loves tricky drop shots and rushing to the net.
story: Nikola's dad is a tennis coach. He put a racket in her hands when she was tiny. As a junior she reached the Wimbledon girls' final. This year she beat a top-10 player at her very first Grand Slam. Now she is in the top 40.

funFacts.text: Her dad is a tennis coach. Her mom learned tennis as a grown-up.
Her big sister played tennis too.
She loves skiing and biking when she has free time.
She loves watching Carlos Alcaraz. Roger Federer and Rafael Nadal are her role models.
She says she plays 'Federer style, Alcaraz style' with lots of tricks.
She is about 6 feet tall and loves reading and Netflix shows.
She says 'I hate defeat,' but she has never once thought about quitting tennis.
She likes old music best, like ABBA and Michael Jackson.

watchFor: Watch for her sneaky drop shots, then a dash to the net for a volley.
